title: Fizzi Cola 2027: win back the on-the-go buyer
decision_requested: Approve Phase 1 of the on-the-go plan (180 coolers, measurement and cluster communications) with a gate review at end of Q2 2027, and stop the planned shift of 40% of trade budget to modern trade
governing_thought: Fizzi is losing on-the-go buyers at the moment of purchase where cold Fizzi is missing; win that moment back with chilled availability in high-footfall clusters, on a repaired supply base, and scale only if Phase 1 proves the uplift

sections.assertion: 2027 must restore buyer growth on a flat TZS 3,200 million budget
sections.exhibit: Objective, budget and constraints on one slide

sections.assertion: Dar es Salaam volume grew only because existing buyers bought more often; the brand lost buyers in both core cities
sections.audience_decision: Accept that buyer loss, not frequency, is the problem
sections.exhibit: Penetration and frequency effects bridge, Dar es Salaam and Mwanza
sections.notes: Mwanza loss overlaps the distributor problem from the H1 diagnosis

sections.assertion: The loss is concentrated in 350 ml, the on-the-go pack; the 1.25 L home pack is growing
sections.exhibit: Pack-level penetration change, Dar es Salaam

sections.assertion: On the way home, the brand with the cold bottle wins: where cold Fizzi is missing, buyers take a cold competitor or skip
sections.audience_decision: Accept the mechanism as the basis for the plan, subject to Phase 1
sections.exhibit: Cooler pilot versus matched outlets; three quotes with respondent IDs
sections.notes: Quotes are analyst glosses of Kiswahili originals
sections.uncertainty: Ten interviews at three locations; pilot matched not randomised; competitor role unmeasured

sections.assertion: Premiumisation, family-pack promotions and the modern-trade shift do not address the buyer loss
sections.exhibit: Options table: mechanism, evidence, economics, why not
sections.notes: The modern-trade assumption was repeated in three plans without data
sections.uncertainty: Premium tier potential untested rather than disproven; audit under-covers informal outlets

sections.assertion: Win the on-the-go cold moment in high-footfall clusters, conditionally and in phases
sections.exhibit: Choice on a page: where to play, how to win, non-choices, conditions
sections.uncertainty: Conditional on Phase 1 uplift replicating and on supply repair in Mwanza

sections.assertion: Coolers pay back in about three years at pilot outlets; high-baseline outlets are needed for a two-year payback
sections.audience_decision: Accept outlet targeting and the gate threshold
sections.exhibit: Break-even chart: incremental litres versus payback years
sections.uncertainty: Built on a small pilot, a margin estimate and unknown uptime; undiscounted

sections.assertion: Five actions, sequenced: repair supply, place coolers with controls, measure retrieval, communicate in clusters, hold modern trade
sections.exhibit: Action timeline with owners and dependencies
sections.uncertainty: Communications budget set only after the retrieval baseline

sections.assertion: We will know by end of Q2 2027 whether to scale, using matched controls and uptime
sections.exhibit: Measurement ladder from reach to penetration with decision rules
sections.notes: Reach is a delivery check only
sections.uncertainty: Situational retrieval baseline not yet measured

sections.assertion: The main risks are non-replication, too few high-baseline outlets and competitor exclusivity deals
sections.notes: Transport price inflation is household-level context, not Fizzi's distribution cost
sections.uncertainty: Competitor cooler count is an estimate; competitor response not assessed

sections.assertion: Approve Phase 1 and stop the modern-trade budget shift today
